featuredArticle.excerpt: Revision 2: the clipping’s happy ending was a teaser. The full account reports a failed portal, a missing Luigi, a Mario-shaped thing in a television, and a Wario who sings. Waluigi filed the teaser; he is amending it, loudly. Mario remains missing; the missing-person file stays open.

editorialDirective.title: WAH! Editorial Directive — Final Ebott Log:
editorialDirective.text: The oath says silence. The machine says record everything. High Command says stop recording. File the contradiction before anyone calls this mission complete. WAH!
